title: ResolutionProposal
description: Matches the live code/schema inspection in docs/migration/01_verified_inventory.md and 04_data_dictionary.md (2026-09-25). No creation timestamp field exists on the live entity, and there is no active/current-proposal marker - a case can have multiple ResolutionProposal rows with no way to determine which is authoritative beyond partial, unreliable text-matching against CustomerCase.resolution_recommendation. See docs/migration/README.md.

recommendation.description: No enum confirmed by the inventory - earlier versions of this schema assumed a fixed enum (replacement/refund/store_credit/reject) from docs/claimflow-luo-playbook.md; that is unconfirmed by the live inspection and has been removed. Treat as free text unless verified otherwise.
